title: Saudi-Led Coalition Says It Destroyed Houthi Missiles Fired Toward Yanbu and Taif
detail: Middle East Eye's live blog reports the Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed Houthi ballistic missiles fired toward Yanbu and Taif. Single live-blog report relaying a coalition claim; Houthi account, launch details and any damage are not yet available.

media.caption: Middle East Eye live blog on coalition interception claim
